prose: John Coleman of Apocatastasis Institute joins Vibe Rant to speak about the logos of learning, academic freedom, how best to guide the youth to be lifelong autodidactic philomaths, and what he's learned about the climate of state run education and homeschool ecosystems. Both parents and the eternally curious will find something to enjoy with the philosophy of pedagogy.
